meta.title: Adult Medicaid annual dental dollar cap, 50 states + DC (2026)
meta.rule: One row = one proof. cap_usd is set only when the quote (verbatim from the page retrieved on retrieved_at) contains the figure; otherwise null. not_verified = no figure or no consistent statement found today.
meta.scope: Largest group of categorically needy Medicaid adults 21-64 (CareQuest rubric Q1); special populations (pregnancy, waivers, ALTCS, IDD) are not the cap shown.

states.period: per state fiscal year (July 1 through June 30)
states.source_title: CareQuest Institute, 2026 Medicaid Adult Dental Coverage Checker (Tableau Public), sheet 'Additional Information', CSV export
states.quote: Adult enhanced dental services are limited to a maximum total reimbursement of $1,150 per state fiscal year (July 1 through June 30).

states.source_title: CareQuest Institute, 2026 Medicaid Adult Dental Coverage Checker (Tableau Public), sheet 'Additional Information', CSV export
states.quote: medically necessary emergency dental services are covered for AHCCCS members 21 years of age and older in an annual amount not to exceed $1,000 per member per contract year (October 1st to September 30th)
states.note: Emergency dental only for AHCCCS adults 21+; ALTCS members additionally have $1,000 for diagnostic, therapeutic and preventive care (same source).
Source scores California 4/6 (annual limit >= $1,000, soft cap) but gives no dollar figure; DHCS pages not retrievable from this host on 2026-10-10.
